description: This file defines extensions and customizations for purchase order and purchase order line models in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including fields, defaults, and methods for invoice creation and order confirmation.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Extension of osv.osv for purchase order lines, adding fields and methods for state, invoicing, and copying data.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Extension of osv.osv for purchase orders, adding methods for invoice creation and order confirmation.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Overrides copy_data to reset state, invoiced status, and invoice lines when copying a purchase order line.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the purchase order line by setting its state to 'confirmed'.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for the purchase order and marks order lines as invoiced.

methods.name: wkf_confirm_order
methods.description: Confirms the purchase order and its draft order lines.
